description: Capability for SplitView's windows. Custom PTY commands (spawn_pty, write_pty, resize_pty, close_pty, list_panes, attach_pty, stash_handoff, take_handoff, read_dir) are app-local and permitted by default; only the minimal core surface is granted here (CLAUDE.md §15). `core:window:allow-close` lets the frontend close a window when its last pane's shell exits; `core:webview:allow-create-webview-window` lets it open a new window (<prefix> n) and pop a pane out into a detached one. The label patterns cover the main window, detached panes (`detached-<paneId>-<seq>`) and new windows (`sv-win-<seq>`) — a capability applies only to the labels it lists, so windows opened at runtime must be matched here too.
